title: Smart Greenhouse & Automated Plant System
subtitle: IoT Microclimate & Soil Moisture Control with ESP8266
description: An automated IoT plant care microclimate system based on the ESP8266 NodeMCU. Continually tracks soil moisture, ambient humidity, and temperature, driving a 4-channel relay to actuate irrigation pumps, cooling fans, and UV growth lamps with an I2C LCD status display.
